voice: original provisional voice; rex built-in, no impersonation

clips.text: [sigh] They hit you. I had hoped they would miss.
Oh. There was less floor there than we needed.

clips.trigger: forward roll lands safely after crossing void
clips.text: You made it across. [pause] I was reasonably certain.
The wall has reconsidered its position.

clips.trigger: a falling object kills an enemy
clips.text: Gravity has resolved that disagreement. Efficient department.

clips.trigger: successful use consumes the final carried unit
clips.text: That was your last one. I assume we have a plan.

clips.trigger: return to a previously visited chamber
clips.text: Back here again. [pause] Yes. We are calling this progress.

clips.trigger: reach the recorded floor of a parent death
clips.text: Your parent stopped here. [sigh] A little further, perhaps.
